remarks: Located southwest of Little Valley, this scenic and private hilltop property offers a unique opportunity for a seasonal cabin, hunting camp, or recreational retreat. The property provides a secluded setting with fantastic views overlooking miles of surrounding hills, and is a deer hunters dream. Upon approach, the property features an approximately 1,200-square-foot off-grid cabin overlooking an open yard, including a guest bunkie. The cabin offers one bedroom plus an open loft that accommodates three additional beds. A covered porch and deck provide comfortable outdoor spaces to relax and take in the peaceful surroundings. The cabin features a metal roof, well water, LP gas, a wood stove and generator power, with electricity available at the road. Inside, the cabin has a vaulted ceiling that adds volume, along with a rustic wood interior that captures the classic feel of a cabin in the woods. A serviceable basic bathroom is in place with on demand hot water. The cabin will require some updates, presenting an opportunity for a new owner to create a personalized country retreat. The hilltop consists of a tillable field currently in hay and native grasses, with a food plot established. Portions of the property are wooded, offering excellent potential to enhance the land with additional food plots. The combination of woods, open acreage, a hilltop food plot creates an attractive setting for hunting and other recreational activities. The tillable field may also offer potential for rental income. With its private setting, scenic hilltop views, recreational acreage and cabin infrastructure already in place, this property can serve well as a hunting camp, seasonal getaway or private retreat. The property is conveniently located close to nearby towns while maintaining the privacy and seclusion many buyers seek in a country property. A potential building lot is also identified as a 2.75 acre opportunity closest to Sawmill Run Road. This is a wonderful property with fantastic hilltop views, a private cabin, woods, open land, hunting potential, recreational opportunities and the ability to further enhance the property for wildlife and outdoor enjoyment.
